not_ready: Police systems are still starting. Try again in a moment.
perm_off_duty: You need to be on duty.
no_permission: You don't have permission to do that.
not_police_target: That person isn't a police officer.
qual_no_self: You can't sign off your own qualification.
qual_granter_needs: Only an officer holding %s can sign off %s.
qual_granted_target: You've been signed off for %s by %s.
qual_revoke_reason: Give a reason for revoking it.
qual_failed: Couldn't save that. Check the server console.
collar_invalid: Collar numbers are digits only, up to %d long.
collar_taken: Collar number %s is already in use.
usage_admin: Usage: /%s status | locations | callouts [on|off|off clear] | callout [scenario] | uncuff [id] | state [id] [key] [json] (debug)
duty_go_to_station: Go to a sign-on point at a station to sign on.
duty_go_to_station_off: Go to a sign-on point at a station to sign off.
duty_need_collar_sergeant: You need a collar number. Ask a sergeant to set one with /collar.
duty_callsign_invalid: Callsigns are letters, numbers and dashes, e.g. 1A-12.
duty_callsign_taken: %s is already in use by another unit.
duty_dispatch_timeout: Dispatch didn't answer, so the callsign couldn't be saved. Try again.
duty_need_report: Write your end-of-shift report before signing off.
duty_use_station: Sign on at a station to go on duty.
duty_ended_job: You've left the police, so your shift has ended.
notebook_bad_correction: You can only correct your own entries.
equipment_go_to_locker: Go to an equipment locker at a station.
equipment_at_max: You already have as much %s as you can draw.
equipment_issue_failed: %s couldn't be issued. Check the item exists in your inventory.
equipment_not_held: You don't have the %s on you.
equipment_uniform_not_allowed: That uniform isn't for your rank or unit.
restraint_you_are_cuffed: You can't do that while you're handcuffed.
restraint_in_vehicle: Get them out of the vehicle first.
restraint_busy: Someone is already dealing with them.
restraint_failed: That didn't work. Stay close and try again.
restraint_no_seat: No free seat in the back.
mdt_no_answer: The MDT didn't answer (%s). Nothing was recorded.
search_asking: Asking them to agree to a search...
search_refused: They didn't agree to be searched. To search them without consent, use your powers and detain them (handcuffs).
search_need_basis: Handcuff them, arrest them or get their consent first.
search_pick_incident: Choose an incident, or start a new one.
arrest_need_grounds: Write your grounds for the arrest (at least %d characters).
arrest_need_necessity: Tick at least one reason the arrest is necessary.
arrest_release_reason: Give a reason for releasing them.
ss_disabled: Stop and search records are switched off.
ss_need_object: Choose what you were searching for.
ss_need_grounds: Record your reasonable grounds for suspicion (at least 20 characters).
ss_need_authorisation: Record the authorising officer and area for this power.
ss_need_gowisely: Confirm you gave the GOWISELY information.
ss_need_person: Describe the person if they wouldn't give a name.
ss_notice_text:
Reference %s
Power: %s
Looking for: %s
Outcome: %s
%s

You can ask for a copy of this record at any police station within 3 months.
roads_need_police_vehicle: You need to be in a police vehicle.
roads_lights_on: Put your blue lights on first.
roads_nothing_ahead: No vehicle in front of you.
roads_too_far: That vehicle is too far away.
roads_stop_started: Stopping %s (%s). Pull in behind it, then use Roadside checks at the vehicle.
roads_notice_text: The police vehicle behind you is signalling you to stop. Pull over when it's safe and stay with your vehicle.
roads_signal_help: Police are signalling you to stop. Pull over when it's safe.
roads_not_your_stop: Open the roadside panel at the vehicle to join this stop.
roads_driver_far: They need to be at the vehicle.
roads_pick_reason: Choose why you stopped the vehicle.
roads_tickets_off: Fixed penalties are switched off, or issued from the MDT on this server.
roads_no_licensing: %s: no licensing system running, points not added
roads_totting: Totting up: the driver has been disqualified.
roads_tor_court: You'll be reported for these offences and may be summoned to court.
npc_busy: Too many NPC stops are running across the city. Finish one first.
npc_one_at_a_time: Finish your current NPC stop first.
npc_cant_talk: You can't do that right now.
npc_need_scanner: You need a mobile fingerprint scanner.
npc_not_in_vehicle: They aren't sitting in the vehicle.
npc_refuses_details: "I don't have to tell you anything." They won't give their details.
npc_gives_details: They give you their name, date of birth and address.
npc_gives_details_nervous: They hesitate, then give you a name, date of birth and address. Their hands are shaking.
npc_warned: You explain that failing to give their details is an offence and they could be arrested.
npc_refuses_out: "Why? I've done nothing wrong." They won't get out.
npc_steps_out: They step out of the vehicle.
npc_bolts: They're out of the door and running!
npc_lost: Lost them. %s has been recorded as failing to stop.
npc_use_npc_search: Use Search the vehicle for an NPC's car.
npc_get_them_out: Get them out of the vehicle first.
roads_locked: It's locked. Get the keys from the driver, or force entry.
roads_force_reason: Give a reason for forcing entry.
roads_forced: Entry forced. The vehicle is unlocked.
roads_search_ox_only: Opening boots and gloveboxes from here needs ox_inventory. Use your inventory's own vehicle search.
roads_pick_power: Choose the power you're seizing it under.
roads_seize_reason: Explain why the vehicle is being seized.
roads_seized_text:
Reference %s
Vehicle %s has been seized under %s.
It will be kept at the police pound. Release fee %s%d. The registered keeper can collect it with proof of ownership, insurance and a valid licence.
test_breath_text: %s requires you to provide a specimen of breath. Failing to provide one without a reasonable excuse is an offence. Choose honestly for your character.
test_drug_text: %s requires you to provide a mouth swab. Failing to provide one without a reasonable excuse is an offence. Choose honestly for your character.
scene_unknown: That isn't in the scene kit.
scene_limit: You've already got %d bits of kit out. Pick some up first.
custody_use_panel: They've been booked in. Release them from the custody panel.
custody_go_to_suite: You need to be in a custody suite.
custody_at_desk: Do this at the custody desk, with the detainee in front of it.
custody_need_rights: Confirm you've given them their rights and entitlements.
custody_booked_target: You've been booked into custody. You can ask for free legal advice, have someone told you're here, and read the codes of practice.
custody_sergeant_only: Only the custody sergeant can change the observation level.
custody_not_rousable: %s is NOT ROUSABLE. Medical attention needed now.
custody_record_on_mdt: Released. Record the outcome on custody record %s in the MDT too.
custody_property_returned: %d items returned. %d left in the bag (they couldn't carry them).
evidence_go_to_store: Go to a custody desk or an equipment locker at a station.
evidence_no_bag: That exhibit has no bag (it was recorded, not bagged).
evidence_bad_status: That isn't a valid move for an exhibit.
evidence_closed: That exhibit has already been returned or destroyed.
evidence_owner_here: The owner needs to be here, next to you.
evidence_cant_carry: They can't carry any of it.
npc_custody_arrived: Prisoner transport has brought %s to %s. Book them in at the desk.
npc_custody_take_to_interview: Take them out of the cell for interview first.
npc_custody_needs_admission: A caution or community resolution needs an admission in interview.
npc_custody_unknown: That isn't something you can do here.
enc_argues: They argue and refuse, but don't get physical.
calls_be_there: You need to be at the scene to close the call.
loc_duplicate: %s is used twice. Names must be different.
loc_bad_point: A place in %s has no position. Press Here for it.
loc_suite_needs: %s needs a custody desk and a release point.
loc_walk_help: Location editor: walk to the spot, then press F7 (or your rebind) to use the editor again.
scene_traffic_closed: Road closed: traffic now stops at your scene. Change it in /scenekit.
scene_traffic_slow: Traffic now slows past your scene. Change it in /scenekit.
equipment_use_armoury: That's signed out and handed back at the armoury.
armoury_unaccounted: Rounds were missing when you signed off. They're recorded as unaccounted for and will be reviewed.
enc_armed_attack: Suspect attacking officers with a weapon
enc_attacks_armed: They come at you with the weapon!
enc_drops_weapon: They drop the weapon and put their hands up.
calls_sighting: Member of the public reports seeing someone matching the description near %s.
incident_too_many: Too many incidents running. Stand one down first.
incident_gone: That incident has been stood down.
incident_go_there: You need to be at the scene.
incident_commander_only: Only the Bronze or Silver commander (or a sergeant) can do that.
incident_not_member: They aren't booked on to the incident.
incident_breach: Inner cordon: %s has gone in and isn't on the incident.
cid_not_yours: Only the officer in case, a sergeant or CID can change that.
cid_need_person: Give a name and a role.
cid_oic_given: You're now the officer in case for %s.
uof_pending: Use of force form started (%s). Complete it in /police, Forms.
uof_not_yours: That form isn't yours, or it's already submitted.
uof_outstanding: You have %d use of force form(s) to complete. Do them in /police, Forms.
complaint_wait: You've made a complaint recently. Please wait before making another.
complaint_need_details: Tell us what happened (at least 30 characters).
standards_need_officer: Enter a collar number, callsign or name.
dog_unit_only: Sign on as Dog section to deploy your dog.
dog_resting: Your dog is being checked over. Ready in %d seconds.
dog_deployed: Dog deployed. Target it for heel, sit and the van; target vehicles and people to search or detain.
dog_in_van: Your dog is in the van.
dog_injured: Your dog has been hurt and is out of action for now.
dog_indicates: The dog sits and stares: it's indicating.
dog_no_players: Dogs can't be sent after players on this server.
stinger_on_foot: Get out of the vehicle to lay it.
stinger_laid: Stinger laid. It's withdrawn automatically after %d seconds, or use /stinger again.
uniform_needs_clothes: %s needs a male or female version: save your clothes for it.
uniform_go_to_changing: Go to a changing room or equipment locker at a station.
callouts_now_on: Automatic callouts are ON. Calls start coming in while officers are signed on.
callouts_now_off: Automatic callouts are OFF. Calls already open carry on. (vpo callouts off clear also cancels ones nobody has reached.)
callouts_now_off_cleared: Automatic callouts are OFF. %d call(s) nobody had reached were cancelled.
callouts_status: Automatic callouts: %s. Open calls: %d (%d with a scene running). Use vpo callouts on | off | off clear.
manage_not_self: You can't do that to yourself.
manage_rank_limit: You can only manage officers below your own rank, and only up to the rank below yours.
manage_rank_not_in_job: %s isn't a grade in that job (check Config.Jobs).
manage_failed: The framework didn't accept the change. Check the server console.
manage_hired_target: Welcome to the %s. You start as %s. Sign on at a station with /police.
manage_unsuspended_target: Your suspension has been lifted. You can sign on again.
perm_not_configured: That action (%s) isn't set up in config/ranks.lua. Tell an admin.
admin_needs_ace: You don't count as an admin here. The server console has the reason: run vpo acecheck with your server id.
custody_no_door: That cell has no door set. Set it with vpo locations, Custody.
custody_door_empty: Locked, but the detainee isn't inside. Return them to the cell from the custody panel.
loc_no_door: No door there. Look straight at the cell door from close by.
world_saved: Saved. It applies for everyone now.
world_save_suite_first: Save the suite in the editor first.
custody_no_cctv: No cameras in this suite yet. Place them with vpo locations, Custody, Place cameras in the world.
